# TulipFleet

TulipFleet is fleet software for Dutch and EU logistics managers who need ZE-Zone risk, 2026 truck toll costs, and driver status on one screen.

## Who it is for

Dutch and Benelux logistics SMEs, typically 5-300 vehicles. The product is built for operators who still run dispatch from Excel and need compliance numbers next to the job list.

## What ships today

- Office panel plus driver phone: assign a job, it lands as a push, the driver accepts, live tracking, then a sealed report.
- Own ESP32 GPS vehicle box (GPS + accelerometer telemetry over TLS-MQTT), not software alone.
- Driver app on iOS and Android. Public site: English, Turkish and Dutch live; six further locale routes prepared (de, fr, es, it, bg, ku). Nine language routes in total.
- 14-day self-service trial: create a company account on /signup/ without a sales call.

## Compliance data (Netherlands)

1. 21 active ZE zones (about 20 cities). Checks and ontheffing use official NDW DATEX II data.
2. Vrachtwagenheffing cost engine with Period-1 toll tariffs loaded.
3. Carbon visibility today, CSRD-aligned reporting on the path ahead. Zone, toll and carbon figures are driven from live telemetry and official feeds, not spreadsheet estimates.

Belgium LEZ / Germany Umweltzone checks and Viapass / LKW-Maut cost sit on the roadmap. TulipFleet does not calculate those foreign tolls today.

## Pricing (EUR per vehicle per month)

- Starter: €15 (1-5 vehicles)
- Professional: €25 (6-20 vehicles)
- Enterprise: €29-35 by volume (20+ vehicles)

10% off on yearly billing. Trial CTA: fourteen days, no credit-card theatre.
